note: Default category weights for the story scheduler (docs/171 §2, §8). normal + world = everyday play (~55%), lifestage ~25%, chaos + occult ~20%. Per-world files in worlds/ multiply these; personas multiply template ids by prefix.
biasMatching: templateBias keys are template id prefixes; the longest matching prefix wins (so world-sv- 3.0 beats world- 0.3). Persona, world and category factors multiply.
